name: accretia
description: Personal mobile-first PWA for tracking net worth, income, savings, and a manually-entered investment portfolio. Public repo with a hostile-reader threat model.

paragraphs: On the two names: the app calls itself Work Optional — that's what it tells you, and what people see. The repo and the site keep the original Accretia (from accretion: growth by accumulation), because a US wealth-management firm already trades as Work Optional and we're not competing for that ground.

Find out when work becomes optional — and keep track of whether you're getting there. A single-page, client-side app with three sections: Track (the home screen: a one-minute monthly check-in — money in, money out, net worth — with money out at three levels of detail — one total, ten categories, or line items inside each category (housing → mortgage payment, property tax, HOA, upkeep; insurance → health, auto, home, life…), each line tagged as an essential, lifestyle or splurge with a three-way split shown as you type; income can be split by source (salary, bonus, side hustle, dividends,…

Use it in Claude (mcp/): a local, end-to-end-encrypted MCP extension for Claude Desktop / Claude Code — say “take-home 11,000, rent 3,200, groceries 600, 401k 1,958” and it's filed into your ledger, synced with the web app as just another device; ask for a year report or whether you're on track, or say “set my food budget to 800”. See mcp/README.md for the security model.
features: Year-by-year projection from a pure, deterministic, unit-tested engine (documented inflation convention, low/mid/high return bands).

Careers with equity — multiple people and career stages, each with base salary, bonus, and annual equity / RSU comp. A browsable, searchable, bilingual role library — tech (L3–L7), medicine, law, finance — provides…

Derived savings, honest compounding — no savings-rate knob: each year you keep whatever's left of after-tax income after spending. But bills come first — you choose the share of that surplus you actually invest; the…
Tax presets — a rough state + federal effective-rate estimate (all 50 states + DC), fully editable.

requirements.text: Everything runs in the browser, and by default nothing is ever sent anywhere — no account needed.

A deployment can optionally enable sign-in with end-to-end-encrypted sync: your data is encrypted on your device with a passphrase only you know, so the server (and whoever runs it) stores ciphertext it cannot read.
